summary: Full end-to-end UI + backend smoke test for SAMAJ CONNECT Phase 1. Verified splash, OTP login as super_admin (+919000000001 / OTP 123456), home dashboard, bottom nav, add-member, member search, social feed post + like, event creation, profile edit, admin panel stats, and logout. All 14 checks passed on mobile viewport 430x900.
passed: Splash renders SAMAJ CONNECT branding and auto-redirects to /login
Home shows quick access tiles (members, social, events, profile)
Bottom mobile nav has home, members, fab-add, events, menu
Add Member form saves and returns to /members with new record visible
Social composer creates post; post-card renders; like button toggles
Event create dialog saves and shows event in Upcoming tab
Admin panel button visible for super_admin; /admin shows 4 stat cards
Logout returns to /login and clears session
Backend endpoints /api/auth/send-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp return 200 with valid JWT
